name: Usotsuki Ouji to Nayameru Ohime-sama -Princess Syndrome-
original_name: うそつき王子と悩めるお姫さま –Princess syndrome–
source:
It’s been two years since the mysterious disease “princess syndrome” had been made public. It affects young girls during puberty and the split personality-like symptoms range from mild to serious. In serious cases, she could become like a totally different person due to her wavering feelings and gain a special ability called ‘märchen’ which could cause great problems to those around her. To combat this problematic illness, all carriers (called ‘princesses’) were gathered at Saint Andersen Private School on the secluded island of Yumegashima. One day, a boy Yuuji came to the school. He was the ‘liar prince’ who could put a stop to their rampaging.

[Edited from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/10/21/october-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
神秘疾病“公主综合症”被公开已有两年了。它影响青春期的年轻女孩，人格分裂样症状从轻微到严重不等。严重时，她可能会因为感情的摇摆而变得完全不同，并获得一种名为“märchen”的特殊能力，这会给周围的人带来很大的麻烦。为了对抗这种棘手的疾病，所有携带者（称为“公主”）都聚集在僻静的梦岛岛上的圣安徒生私立学校。有一天，一名男孩雄二来到了学校。他是能够阻止他们暴行的‘骗子王子’。

[编辑自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/10/21/october-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
